items.name: Dragon Mouth Pistol
items.description: Similar to the blunderbuss, a dragon-mouth pistol fires pellets from a flared barrel. Though less powerful than a blunderbuss, the dragon-mouth pistol is appreciated for its portability and one-handed design. Though the name was coined because of the destructive belch of this handheld scatter weapon, many gunsmiths craft dragon-mouth pistols with elaborate embellishments that resemble a stylized dragon's maw framing the barrel.

items.name: Steel Plating (Functions as Half Plate)
items.description: Half plate consists of most of the upper body plates used in full plate, with lighter or sparser steel plate protection for the arms and legs. This provides some of the protection of full plate with greater flexibility and speed. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Padded Armor] and a pair of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Gauntlet]{gauntlets}.

items.name: Artisan's Toolkit (Blacksmithing)
items.description: You need these tools to create items from raw materials with the Craft skill. Different sets are needed for different work, as determined by the GM; for example, a blacksmith's toolkit differs from a woodworker's toolkit. If you wear your artisan's toolkit, you can draw and replace it as part of the action that uses it.

items.name: Repair Toolkit
items.description: A repair kit allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. It contains a portable anvil, tongs, woodworking tools, a whetstone, and oils for conditioning leather and wood. You can use a repair kit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. You can draw and replace a worn repair toolkit as part of the action that uses it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Extend Arms
offensiveAbilities.description: The dynamo extends their collapsible steel arms, giving them both a reach of 20 feet with all melee attacks. However, the dynamo becomes Enfeebled 1 and can't use the Interact action. The dynamo can Dismiss this ability.

offensiveAbilities.name: Extend Legs
offensiveAbilities.description: The dynamo rises into the air on 10-foot-tall telescoping steel legs. While their legs are extended, the dynamo gains a +10-foot status bonus to land Speed and ignores any cover granted by barriers less than 10 feet tall. However, the dynamo becomes Clumsy 1 and can't use the Climb, Leap, Swim, or Tumble Through actions. The dynamo can Dismiss this ability.

offensiveAbilities.name: Modular Prostheses
offensiveAbilities.description: The dynamo configures one or both of their mechanical prosthetic hands into a specific configuration. Each configuration deals a specific damage type and has its own weapon traits: fist (bludgeoning; free-hand), gaff hook (piercing; grapple), impact driver (bludgeoning; shove), or spinning blade (slashing; trip). The dynamo can alternatively transform a hand into a steel shield with Hardness 8, HP 72, and BT 36. A broken prosthesis can't be reconfigured until repaired.
